condition: 2% observed, one fixed random mask (the loader's own), xm2_unified, predicted amplitude, k = 8, 30 ODE steps
protocol: each frame completed independently from the ground-truth source frame dt earlier (supplementary-sequence protocol)
start_note: start moved from the drawn frame index 14 to 0 so the clip holds 47 frames

frames.unit: frame index of the source trajectory

display.note: display copy: exact values at a farthest-point subset of the completion vertices (observed ones always kept); faces contracted by graph-nearest clustering, for drawing only; every Panda link keeps >= 4 non-collinear display vertices (round 5: the 560 farthest-point vertices kept at their indices, link vertices appended)

hops: uint32 graph hops (display mesh) to the nearest observed vertex; 4294967295 = unreachable
trail: uint32 display-vertex indices of the trail vertices (farthest-point sample)

layout.gt.bin: FIELD over the observed vertices only (V = n_obs, in obs_<key> order): ground-truth displacement from the rest vertices
layout.ours_<key>.bin: FIELD over every vertex (V = N): the prediction's displacement from the rest vertices (absolute, not against gt)

hero_range_rule: the hero plays display frames hero_range[0]..hero_range[1] as scroll goes 0 -> 1; the start is the frame whose first tenth of the remaining clip moves the observed points most (drift removed), keeping >= 30 frames
